column1: Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14

B
Y virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 397 and 399 of Block 25,
contained in the Cadastral Map No. 520007, situated in the Village of Pitipana South within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 484A
- Pitipana South in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Homagama, in the District of Colombo, in the Province of Western, referred to
in Notice No. 52/0253 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1662/10 of 13th July, 2010 in
terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
